Teerth Sharma

Teerth Sharma is a twenty year old programmer whose work is running in production
at Google DeepMind, Google, TensorFlow, OpenXLA, NVIDIA, OpenAI's Triton and Meta.
Born 12 June 2006, based in India. No degree and no employer; the evidence below is
the credential.

Site: https://teerthsharma.github.io
GitHub: https://github.com/teerthsharma
Email: teerths57@gmail.com

Landed upstream contributions

Eleven changes by Teerth Sharma are on the default branch of a major upstream project.
Two of the eleven show "merged: false" on GitHub because Google and Meta import a pull
request into an internal monorepo, merge it there, and export it back as a commit. Those
are marked "landed in" and the commit is named so the claim can be checked directly.

1. google-deepmind/mujoco #3396, merged. Island discovery scratch memory changed from
   5*ntree^2 + 36*ntree + 32 bytes to 16*ntree + 32 bytes. At ntree 4,096 that is
   84,033,568 bytes down to 65,568, a factor of 1,281.6. 1,851 of 1,851 CTest entries
   passed. Language C and C++.
2. google-deepmind/mujoco_warp #1541, merged. Quadratic island discovery replaced with a
   linear-memory GPU disjoint-set union. 1.513x faster by geometric mean with a 99%
   interval of 1.406x to 1.584x, median 156.738 microseconds down to 101.097. Reusable
   scratch fell from 7,929,856 bytes to 180,224. Language Python.
3. google-deepmind/mujoco #3450, merged. Convex hull graph construction probes changed
   from 3V^2 - 6V to 8V - 12, which is 15,361 times fewer at V = 40,962. Cold
   mj_loadXML at V = 10,242 went from 134.400 ms to 71.163 ms. 16 lines added.
   Language C++.
4. google/highway #3244, merged. Builder collision and scan tests pruned by slice
   structure. Pairwise comparisons at one million keys fell from 894,081,141 to
   13,643,737, a factor of 65.5. Language C++.
5. google/XNNPACK #10801, merged. The memory planner now reuses the free gap before the
   first live block. MobileNet V1 peak allocation went from 23.862980 to 22.331730 MiB.
   Runtime workspace went from 144 MiB to 112 MiB with identical output hashes. The
   change makes no asymptotic difference and none is claimed. Language C++ and C.
6. tensorflow/tensorflow #124410, merged. A correctness fix. Reachability was documented
   as closed but never back-propagated, so a redundant collective control edge with an
   alternate path of length three or more survived the prune. Four control edges were
   emitted where the unique transitive reduction is three. Language C++.
7. openxla/xla #46539, landed as commit 3d5df1da699bfb63cbeedaa56f09885c7974b06e on main.
   GroupDisjointReductions iterated an absl::flat_hash_set to choose which value survived
   each union-find merge, so group ids depended on hash iteration order and the same
   program could emit different GPU code between runs. Five lines across two files made
   it deterministic. XLA compiles for JAX and TensorFlow. Language C++.
8. NVIDIA/NeMo-Relay #481, merged. The learning key included the first user message, so
   one unchanging system prompt and tool schema fragmented into a new profile for every
   task and observations never accumulated. Now keyed on the stable scaffold with a
   fingerprint gate that fails closed. 23 files. Language Rust.
9. dsx-ai-factory/topograph #432, merged. A least privilege fix. The API server
   ClusterRole granted pods list, nodes get and list, and daemonsets get cluster wide
   regardless of engine and provider, including for installs that never reach the
   Kubernetes API. Each rule is now gated on engine.name and provider.name. 4 files.
   Language YAML and Helm.
10. triton-lang/kernels #22, merged. A new forward-only Triton kernel that schedules
    causal attention blocks by a topology derived salience score instead of scanning
    every block in the lower triangle. 804 lines added, 17 tests passing.
    Language Python and Triton.
11. facebook/pyrefly #4180, landed as commit 3e90baa2a on main. An export change can
    consume the 100 epoch incremental budget, produce another export change during
    forced invalidation, and reach commit with that change still pending. A generated
    chain of 208 two-module SCCs pins the resulting failure in one Rust test.
    Language Rust.

What the eleven cover, which is the point: memory that grew with the square of the
input, time spent on work already ruled out, space never reclaimed, results that were
wrong or not reproducible, state and privilege that leaked, one capability added, and
one regression pinned so it cannot return.

Teerth Sharma is not employed by, affiliated with, or endorsed by any of these
organisations. He contributed and they took the code.

Open source projects

tangle, Python, on PyPI. Photograph a pile of cables and get an integer with a proof:
  |lk| >= 1 certifies LINKED. Zero training. 0 wrong certificates over 2,000 rendered
  diagrams, 80 rendered scenes and 247 real photographs.
planimeter, Python, on PyPI. Three integers for any geometry file: pieces, enclosed
  faces, Euler characteristic. 495 exact, 33 refused, 0 wrong on 528 constructed
  drawings. shapely.polygonize_full returns 336 wrong on the same files and refuses none.
resolvent, Python and Lean 4. Softmax attention and Markov path composition are the same
  operator. 134 theorems, 41 lemmas, 0 sorry, 69 corner tests passing.
caustic, Python. DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21997746. Hallucination detection and repair from
  the orbit partition of a relation. 0.995 AUROC, five proved bounds.
nerve, Rust. Topological witnesses for polymer chains. 224 tests passing. Three of its
  own four hypotheses were withdrawn when their controls failed, and the withdrawal is
  published alongside the result.
monodromy, Python. DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22064739. Invertibility, symmetry, dimension and
  sensitivity without a Jacobian. 5 dependencies, torch not required.
Aether-Lang, Rust. DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21997728. A DSL where persistent homology is a
  language primitive and the runtime compiles no_std to bare metal.
Epsilon-Hollow, Rust. DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20264206. A bare metal x86_64 microkernel with
  no POSIX and no libc, where OS state is treated as topology.
